items.html: And the matter is in this manner. It has been explained that the lights of the Ozen expanded down to the Shibolet [strand] of the beard, and that the lights of Hotem and Peh also pass through there. If so, it is necessary that when the light of the Einayim of AK is extended through there, it will mingle with them and take their light. Now, of the ten Nekudot, the first three among them take light from what is extended from the look of the eye at AHP, from their place down to the place of their conjunction at the Shibolet of the beard, as is known; and they receive them only at the Shibolet of the beard, for from there they begin, and not from what is above the Shibolet of the beard. But the seven lower Nekudot take only from what is extended from the look at the lights of the Hotem and the Peh, from the Shibolet of the beard downward, as is known; for the Hotem reaches to the Chazeh and the Peh to the Tabur, and not from above the Shibolet of the beard.
